description: Confirmatory real-domain few-shot adaptation on previously unseen RRUFF-301. RRUFF-70 is downgraded to exploratory pilot. All protocol choices frozen before any model access to RRUFF-301 data.

adaptation_pool.usage: K shot support sampled from this pool only

locked_test.usage: fixed test set, identical across all K and all episodes

preregistered_checkpoints.selection: Validation-selected best epoch, frozen before any real-domain access

adaptation_layers.frozen_modules: stem, stages.0-3 (all convolutional and normalization layers)

optimizer.rationale: Same nominal learning rate as pretraining contract

early_stopping.forbidden: query accuracy must NOT be used for epoch selection

fixed_test_set.description: All K values and all episodes use the same 231-sample locked test set
fixed_test_set.benefit: Test composition does not vary with K or episode seed

sensitivity_check.description: Fixed 200-step run for K=1 and K=5, no early stopping, to confirm delta direction is robust to stopping rule
sensitivity_check.execution: Run after primary experiment, before reporting conclusions

primary_metric.name: Macro-F1
primary_metric.computation: Per-class F1, then unweighted mean across 7 crystal systems
primary_metric.rationale: JS benefit is class-dependent; accuracy masks per-class effects

stratified_deltas.by_pretraining_seed: 5 deltas per K (averaging over episode seeds)
stratified_deltas.by_episode_seed: 5 deltas per K (averaging over training seeds)

per_class_breakdown.description: Per-class F1 for JS and ERM at each K
per_class_breakdown.special_attention: monoclinic — confirm or refute the -0.09 negative transfer observed in RRUFF-70 pilot

analysis_plan.confusion_matrices: For each K, aggregated across all 25 JS runs

bootstrap.caveat: deltas are not fully independent (shared pretrained seeds and overlapping adaptation pool samples). Report as descriptive, not as formal significance test.

zero_shot.description: Same 10 checkpoints, direct inference on 231-sample locked test, no training

sensitivity_analysis.protocol: Fixed 200 optimizer steps, no early stopping, K=1 and K=5 only
sensitivity_analysis.purpose: Verify delta direction is not an artifact of early-stopping budget differences

allowed: JS produces representations with consistently improved few-shot adaptability to experimental PXRD (if delta positive in majority of pairs)
The improvement is class-dependent (if per-class deltas show systematic variation)
Monoclinic negative transfer observed in RRUFF-70 pilot is [confirmed / not replicated] in RRUFF-301 (report whichever occurs)
forbidden: JS advantage increases monotonically with K (unless fixed-step check confirms)
Any post-hoc selection of K, episode seeds, training seeds, checkpoints, or metrics
Any claim based on inspecting results before freezing protocol
Retuning lambda, optimizer, or architecture after seeing 301 results
conditional: If monoclinic negative transfer replicates: discuss as method boundary (JS consistency may trade off fine-grained structural discrimination)
If monoclinic negative transfer does not replicate: attribute RRUFF-70 result to small-sample composition of the 10 monoclinic samples

to_be_written_before_execution: rruff301_adaptation_test_split.csv (adapted from RRUFF-371 extension manifest, excluding RRUFF-70 IDs)
rruff301_episode_plan.csv (pre-generated support/query assignments for each K and episode seed)

execution_rules.single_run: All K values, all episode seeds, zero-shot, and sensitivity check executed in ONE script before inspecting any result
execution_rules.no_incremental: Do not run K=1, inspect, then run K=2. Do not run ERM, inspect, then run JS.
execution_rules.no_sample_exclusion: No sample removed post-hoc based on prediction or loss
execution_rules.no_relabel: No sample relabeled based on model output
